tokens.name: primary

tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills. 5.0:1 light, 6.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Tabler primary-lt. Selected rows, active nav item background.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Tabler purple as the AI accent: AI trace, assistant badges, the sparkle icon, assistant-written marks. 4.9:1 on white, 5.3:1 on bg-surface dark, so it works as text and icon too.

tokens.name: on-ai
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ai fills.

tokens.name: ai-subtle
tokens.usage: Tint behind assistant-written messages and draft proposals.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element. 4.8:1 on bg-body light, 6.3:1+ dark.

tokens.name: success-subtle

tokens.usage: Warning words and small icons (TTL under 15 min, budget 80%). 5.3:1 on white, 8.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners.

tokens.name: danger

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and blocked Inbox cards.

tokens.name: info

tokens.usage: Info words and small icons. 5.3:1 on white, 7.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of info banners (triage postponed).
